plain_english: When the yogin abides with mind-wind dissolved in the inward aim — he, seeing yet not seeing outside with unmoving-pupil gaze — this indeed becomes the śāmbhavī mudrā, by your grace, O guru: devoid of void and non-void becomes that reality, the śāmbhava state.
sanskrit_cite: antarlakṣyavilīnacittapavanaḥ yogī yadā vartate dṛṣṭyā niścalatārayā bahir asau paśyan apaśyan api mudreyam | khalu śāmbhavī bhavati sā yuṣmatprasādāt guro śūnyāśūnyavivarjitam bhavati yat tattvam padam śāmbhavam
